newsitem.title: USA: Lenfest says it and News Corp settle suits.
newsitem.headline: Lenfest says it and News Corp settle suits.

text.p: Lenfest Communications Inc and News Corp Ltd have settled lawsuits filed in the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania and the Supreme Court of New South Wales, Lenfest said on Monday.

The lawsuits were settled by agreeing to dismiss all claims without payment of any damages, Lenfest said in a statement. The companies had filed lawsuits against each other in a dispute over an alleged oral agreement related to the recapitalisation of pay tv operator Australis Media Ltd.
News Corp had contended that Lenfest had agreed not to negotiate with Australis without first consulting News Corp.
Lenfest is a part owner of Australis Media.
News Corp filed its suit against Lenfest in Australia, while Lenfest filed its action against News Corp in federal court in Pennsylvania.
